title: CPETLite: teacher-student cardiopulmonary exercise reconstruction code
description: Portable four-YAML configuration and unified execution interface for the frozen CPETLite principal/control implementations, with CLI/synthetic tests and a bounded real-data smoke summary. Scientific model/loss code is unchanged from v1.0.0. Clinical records, supervision, weights, individual predictions, aggregate clinical datasets and private manuscripts are excluded. This is offline reconstruction research, not a validated medical device.
